application: Wearable B-mode imaging and pulse-echo sensing
controller: MSP430 acquisition controller; ESP32 Wi-Fi/USB host
data_link: USB CDC, Wi-Fi (TCP); legacy BLE option

specs.framerate: up to 500 Hz PRF (1 channel) or 18 FPS in B-mode (16 channels)
specs.power: 40 mW at 50 Hz PRF (acquisition front end)

access_detail: Open hardware (Solderpad v0.51), software (Apache-2.0), and Firmware (Apache-2.0, see repository)
description: WULPUS Pro Max is a complete wearable ultrasound acquisition system designed for pulse-echo sensing and B-mode imaging. It features a 16-channel, time-multiplexed front end compatible with PZT and CMUT transducers. A companion ESP32-C6 board enables raw data streaming over USB or Wi-Fi at pulse repetition frequencies (PRFs) of up to 500 Hz. The system operates through a single USB-C connection in wired mode or on battery power in wireless mode. An intuitive desktop GUI simplifies system configuration, real-time visualization, and firmware updates, enabling quick and straightforward setup.

hw.notes: Acquisition and Wi-Fi host boards can be ordered as separate PCBWay shared projects or self-built.
